verify_line_length: verify line length in a file to ensure no lines exceed a maximum character limit
verify_tabs: verify a file has no tab characters and enforce whitespace-only indentation
verify_trailing_whitespace: verify a file has no trailing whitespace on any line
run_lint_over_all_files: run a custom linter subclass over a list of files to collect violations
review_base_lint: review the BaseLint class as a base class for implementing custom file linters
